# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.1 Stage 2 Package 4, Chagatai 1347 Split & Eurasian Building-Type Governors (oe_eug_). Generated by gen_eurasia_governors.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Chagatai player centralization counter-path ("Restore Chagatai's Yassa").
oe_eug_dec_chg_restore_yassa = {
    decision_category = government_decisions
    only_once = yes
    only_once_scope = country
    potential = {
        tag = CHG
        has_global_variable = oe_eug_on
        NOT = { global_var:oe_eug_chg_split ?= 1 }
        NOT = { global_var:oe_eug_chg_split ?= 2 }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        stability >= 10
        prestige >= 15
        gold >= 100
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:soldiers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_eug_dec_chg_restore_yassa.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -100
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_chg_split value = 2 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_eug_chg_yassa_restored years = 40 mode = replace }
            if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:YSU }
                c:YSU = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_eug_b_kurultai_accord target = c:CHG } }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:DGH }
                c:DGH = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_eug_b_kurultai_accord target = c:CHG } }
            }
        }
    }
}

# 2. Delhi repeatable audit decision (restores loyal state on active viceroyalties).
oe_eug_dec_dlh_audit_viceroys = {
    decision_category = government_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        tag = DLH
        has_global_variable = oe_eug_on
        global_var:oe_eug_dlh_state ?= 2
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 90
        stability >= 0
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_eug_dlh_audit_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:burghers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_eug_dec_dlh_audit_viceroys.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -90
            set_variable = { name = oe_eug_dlh_audit_cd months = 60 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_eug_dlh_state value = 1 }
            oe_eug_sync_dlh_modifiers = yes
        }
    }
}
